newsitem.title: USA: Equifax to buy CUNA card services unit.
newsitem.headline: Equifax to buy CUNA card services unit.

text.p: Equifax Payment Services, a unit of Equifax Inc, said Monday it entered into an agreement to buy the credit and debit card services division of CUNA Service Group Inc (CSG).
Terms of the agreement were not disclosed.
The deal is subject to the approval of CSG's shareholders and Equifax's board of directors.

CUNA is the trade association for some 21,150 credit unions. CSG Card Services processes cards for credit unions, with more than $72 million in revenues. It handles card processing for 2,500 credit union with more than 4.5 million accounts, CSG said.
Once the agreement is final, Equifax will handle processing services for 17 million cardholders and 5,000 financial institutions, the company said.
